description: Requests abort of an Actor run that is starting or running. No effect if the run already finished.

name: abort-actor-run

status.description: Run status: READY | RUNNING | TIMING-OUT | TIMED-OUT |.

storages.description: Dataset and key-value store metadata, keyed by alias.

fields.description: Dataset field paths in dot notation (e.g. ["metadata.url"])

datasets.description: Map of dataset alias → metadata. Key "default" is always.
